parent_binding.noncircularity: PREW13 binds immutable predecessor receipts and source/object digests externally; it contains no self hash and no future production digest.

required_predecessors: accepted frozen S1 source and tiny receipts
accepted frozen S2 source and tiny verdicts
accepted controller-owned third-route tiny oracle receipts
accept verdict from all four read-only audits

third_route_oracle.ownership: controller-owned source, image, fixtures, and verdict; no model candidate authors expected values
third_route_oracle.separation: no import/copy/shared arithmetic with S1 or S2 and no access to their source trees
third_route_oracle.method: independently reconstruct exact tiny Q,F,H,d,e,X,k,W,R,cell and compare controller-ingested canonical projections
required_tests: [7,11) first without predecessors or supplied endpoint state
all route pairs and third route agree
synthetic N/N+1, unscaled-Q, unscaled-F missing 10^(N+1), pole-sign, endpoint, gcd, remainder, cell, byte, digest, gap/overlap/reorder mutations are rejected

hidden synthetic 256-point fixtures drive both S1 and S2 production statistic paths and mutations of counts, J, every C/A/Z family, internal derived C0=256 enforcement, max numerator/denominator, lexicographic tie witness, identities, decision field, and decision precedence are rejected; C0 is never emitted

decision: PREW13 can only reject or record readiness for explicit operator review. Its JSON must always contain window13_authorized=false. Any window13_action field in predecessor artifacts is operational only when window_index is exactly 13 and is inert in synthetic or other-index validation. A separate later controller contract and operator action are required before any production byte exists.
nonclaims: PREW13 is workflow readiness only. It computes no window-13 point/statistic and proves no occupancy, density, cancellation, V1, decimal occurrence, or Pi result.
